title: Snake
description: The classic, tuned to feel good: smooth gliding movement, juicy eats and a speed ramp that keeps every run tense. Eat pellets to grow and score; hit a wall or yourself and it's over.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to turn. Space or Enter to restart.
controls.touch: Swipe to turn. Keep your finger down and draw an L to turn twice.

thumbnailAlt: A lime-green snake gliding across a dark dotted grid toward a pink pellet
